product.title: Private, Bespoke Yellowstone Summer Wildlife Photo Safaris

description.text: Custom summer photo safaris route through Lamar Valley, Hayden Valley, and canyon overlooks with a photographer guide who coaches composition and exposure settings. The eight- to ten-hour day flexes between wildlife telephoto opportunities and landscape shots at Grand Prismatic Spring and the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone.

highlights: Bespoke summer wildlife and landscape photo safari
Lamar Valley and Hayden Valley wildlife photography
Grand Prismatic Spring color and steam compositions
Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone rim landscapes

start.description: Pickup from West Yellowstone or Gardiner area hotels before dawn for Lamar Valley light.

end.description: Return to your pickup location after the final canyon or geyser basin photo stop.
